chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The distinction between the Muslims and the polytheists is the wearing of turbans."

key_terms.التَّلَحِّي: the act of wearing or wrapping oneself with a turban
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims, the community of Islam
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: the polytheists, those who associate partners with Allah

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say distinguishes Muslims from polytheists in dress?
ai.summary: This hadith states that adopting the turban is among the outward distinctions associated with Muslims in contrast to the polytheists. It reflects a Prophetic tradition concerning visible communal identity and attire.
